speakers.description: A Korean woman in her early 30s, a young mother. Warm, gentle, mid-pitched voice with clear standard Seoul pronunciation.
A Korean man in his mid 30s, a young father. Friendly, slightly low baritone voice with clear standard Seoul pronunciation.
A Korean grandmother in her late 60s. Kind, soft, slightly husky voice, speaking a little slowly with standard Korean pronunciation.
